title: Pilot Trial of Ambient Listening for Intensive Care Unit Family Meeting Summaries
official: Pilot Trial of Ambient Listening for Intensive Care Unit Family Meeting Summaries (PALMS)
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn whether ambient listening can help healthcare providers create written summaries of conversations with the families of patients in the medical intensive care unit (ICU). Ambient listening is an artificial intelligence-enabled tool that records a medical visit and creates a written summary. Healthcare providers already use this technology for many types of appointments. The main questions this trial aims to answer are: Do patients, families, and healthcare providers feel comfortable using ambient listening to record and summarize ICU family meetings? and How much do healthcare providers use content created by ambient listening when it is available to them? and Can ambient listening generate useful summaries of family meetings for patients and their families? Researchers will compare clinical summaries written using an AI-enabled tool to summaries written without the tool to see if using ambient listening makes summaries clearer and more useful to healthcare providers.

Participants will:

Allow researchers to record and transcribe a family meeting with the patient's ICU medical team.
conditions: Documentation of Serious Illness Communication for Critically Ill Patients

interventions.name: Receipt of ambient listening-generated draft clinical note

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be the surrogate decision maker for a patient admitted to a participating medical intensive care unit; and
* Have a family meeting scheduled with the patient's medical team.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Be less than 18 years of age; or
* Be the surrogate of a patient who is less than 18 years of age; or
* Have a preferred language other than English.
